purpose: Third expanded public source layer focused on under-covered medicinal heteroaromatics, saturated N-heterocycles, antibiotic semisynthesis cores, redox scaffolds, chelator/linker modalities, and compliance-gated bioconjugate payload systems.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate stock, fermentation-core, or reviewed-anchor decision
route-specific regioselectivity, stereoselectivity, and protecting-group review
antimicrobial stewardship, cytotoxic payload, radiochemical, and biosecurity review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
ADC payload/linker, radiopharmaceutical, antibiotic, siderophore, and PROTAC entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Azaindoles, indazoles, imidazopyridines, and fused aza-heteroaromatics
families.strategic_principle: Build the fused aza-heteroaromatic core from aminopyridine, ortho-halo/ortho-functionalized aryl, hydrazine/nitroso, or alpha-carbonyl partners before treating late C-H/SNAr/cross-coupling decoration as SAR exploration.

families.name: Purines, pyrimidines, pyrrolopyrimidines, and nucleobase-like heterocycles
families.strategic_principle: Separate nucleobase-like heterocycle core formation from site-selective C2/C4/C5/C6 substitution and from sugar/prodrug installation. Substitution order and tautomer/regioisomer control are strategic, not cosmetic.

families.name: Piperazines, morpholines, azetidines, and saturated N-heterocycle medicinal motifs
families.strategic_principle: Distinguish late medicinal amine/linker installation from true saturated-ring construction. For substituted or chiral saturated N-heterocycles, expose ring-building, ring-opening, or chiral-pool anchors rather than generic amine alkylation.

families.name: Beta-lactones, strained lactones, benzolactams, and non-antibiotic lactam/lactone scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect lactones/lactams to hydroxy-acid, amino-acid, beta-hydroxy acid, or acyl-activation precursors. For beta-lactones, ring strain and irreversible acylation biology require separate risk tags from ordinary ester retrosynthesis.

families.name: Quinones, hydroquinones, naphthoquinones, and redox-active natural-product scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Treat quinone/hydroquinone interchange as an oxidation-state strategy and disconnect substituted naphthoquinones through oxidation, annulation, or nucleophilic substitution only when regioselectivity and redox stability are explicit.

families.name: Aminoglycoside antibiotics and amine-rich sugar semisynthesis
families.strategic_principle: Use fermentation-derived aminoglycoside cores as reviewed semisynthesis anchors. Strategic work is regioselective amine/hydroxyl protection, acylation/alkylation, and resistance-avoidance modification, not rebuilding the full aminosugar architecture.

families.name: Tetracycline polyketide antibiotics and semisynthetic tetracycline cores
families.strategic_principle: Treat tetracycline cores as fermentation/semisynthesis or reviewed total-synthesis platform anchors. Prioritize oxidation-state, C7/C9 substitution, and dimethylamino/amide edits with explicit antibiotic-stewardship policy.

families.name: Siderophores, hydroxamates, catecholates, and iron-chelating antibiotic vectors
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect siderophore motifs to hydroxamate/catechol/carboxylate chelation units and peptide/linker backbones. Chelation geometry, iron-binding state, and antimicrobial-vector compliance are required route metadata.

families.name: PROTACs and heterobifunctional targeted-protein-degrader linkers
families.strategic_principle: Disconnect degraders to POI warhead, linker, and E3 ligase ligand modules. Linker length, attachment vectors, exit-vector chemistry, and ternary-complex behavior determine strategic value; ordinary linker coupling is insufficient.

families.name: Antibody-drug-conjugate payload/linker and bioconjugation motifs
families.strategic_principle: Compliance-gated route critique only: separate cytotoxic payload, cleavable/noncleavable linker, self-immolative spacer, and antibody conjugation handle. Stability and release mechanism are strategic metadata.

families.name: Radiopharmaceutical chelators, bifunctional chelators, and isotope-bearing linkers
families.strategic_principle: Compliance-gated route critique only: separate targeting vector, pharmacokinetic linker, bifunctional chelator, and isotope/metal choice. Radiolabeling compatibility and chelator-metal stability must remain explicit.

source_notes.summary: The v4 expansion fills source gaps listed in NEXT_SOURCE_BACKLOG.md: fused aza-heteroaromatics, nucleobase-like cores, saturated N-heterocycles, lactone/lactam motifs, quinone redox scaffolds, antibiotic semisynthesis anchors, siderophore chelators, PROTAC linkers, ADC linker-payloads, and radiopharmaceutical chelator-linkers.

Antibiotic, siderophore, PROTAC, ADC, radiopharmaceutical, quinone, beta-lactone, hydrazine, and azide-adjacent entries are advisory records. Promotion to proposal generation requires project-level safety, legal, antimicrobial-stewardship, radiochemical, or biosecurity review as applicable.
